capabilities: Expose frontmatter items as data-* attributes on the note container
Style notes with CSS snippets using attribute selectors
Convert frontmatter lists and objects to JSON in attributes
disambiguation: It does not edit or display frontmatter; it only exposes it as HTML data attributes for CSS selectors.
problem: Obsidian notes' frontmatter metadata is not exposed in the HTML, so CSS snippets cannot target notes by their properties.
summary: Plugin that copies each YAML frontmatter item onto the note's HTML container as a data-* attribute for CSS styling.
